_help.about: Edit this file to control the promotional items shown on the free version. Everything is hidden automatically while the Pro add-on is active.
_help.enabled: Master switch. false hides every promo item.
_help.show_close: true = items have a close (x) button. false = no close button, the item always stays. Can also be set per slot.
_help.remember_dismiss: Only matters when the close button is shown. true = a closed item stays closed (see reshow_days). false = closing only hides it until the next page refresh, so it appears again every time. Can also be set per slot.
_help.slots: header_text = text in the centre of the top bar. builder_box = box under 'Save as default for new popups' in the builder. dashboard_slider = sliding images in a movable Dashboard box (drag it like the other boxes; its height follows the slides). menu_item = extra link at the end of the WpPopPop admin menu.
_help.per slot: enabled (true/false), start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, optional schedule), show_close (true/false, overrides the top-level value), remember_dismiss (optional, overrides the top-level value), reshow_days (a closed item appears again after this many days; 0 = only when its id or content changes), id (optional; change it to show a closed item again).
_help.fields:
title, text (links , , ,
allowed), cta (button label), url, new_tab (true/false), image (a file name inside the plugin's promo/ folder, or a full URL).
_help.colors: text_color, bg_color, cta_text_color, cta_bg_color: hex values such as #ffffff. Leave empty to use the Theme page colours. Slides inherit the slot colours unless they set their own.
_help.dashboard_slider: interval = milliseconds between slides. slides = list of entries with the fields above (maximum 8).
_help.menu_item: text = menu label (default Go PRO), url = where it links, text_color and bg_color = menu item colours.
_help.note: JSON does not allow comments or trailing commas. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Put images in the promo/ folder.
_help.plugin_link: Link on the Plugins screen, right after 'Deactivate'. text = label (default Go PRO), url = where it links, new_tab (true/false), text_color = hex colour of the text (empty = Theme primary colour). enabled=false removes it.
